clarification.en: All Public Sector Banks are Scheduled Commercial Banks, but not all Scheduled Commercial Banks are Public Sector Banks (e.g., Private and Foreign banks).

relationship.en: SCBs act as the primary transmission mechanism for RBI's monetary policy rates.
